answer: An established miner may sponsor at most one newcomer per epoch by locking a cedar-backed voucher equal to a day's emission. The newcomer must publish a public beacon of unique work hashes and vault-signed heartbeats for two full epochs; voting weight vests only at dawn of the third, and only after a second, independent sponsor attests the same trail. If two newcomers share work-hash prefixes, heartbeat skew, or vault certs, both vouchers slash and neither seat vests. A sybil farm then needs many independent established sponsors plus delayed unique work, not just fresh keys.
